blockers.description: No test starts a live HTTP server and executes a multi-plan task against it. All claimed e2e tests use in-process faux providers.
blockers.evidence: Code review of all e2e-*.test.ts files and scripts/run-*.ts files confirms no server startup.

blockers.description: No test creates, schedules, and executes a realistic multi-plan task against a live system.
blockers.evidence: The real-agent-mini-multiplan-gate.ts creates synthetic plan artifacts but uses deterministic mode by default.

blockers.description: No test measures average, peak, or sustained parallelism across real async assembly execution.
blockers.evidence: P45 concurrency and load profile scripts are stubs with empty function bodies.

blockers.description: No single gauntlet or make target centralizes all strongest tests (real-agent, P45, P49, execution stability).
blockers.evidence: make test runs only test/execution-gauntlet/. make test-full omits real-agent, P45, and P49. Neither is in CI.

blockers.description: make test-full does not include the most critical tests: real-agent mini-multiplan gate, P45 scripts, P49 ACCP e2e.
11 files named e2e but all use faux/deterministic providers, no live server. Names are misleading.
blockers.evidence: Read of e2e-flagship.test.ts, e2e-plan-execution.test.ts, e2e-accp-native-flow.test.ts confirms faux providers.

blockers.description: 8 dogfood test files exist but none are wired into CI workflows.
blockers.evidence: CI workflows show only npm test and mini-execution-correctness. No dogfood targets.

blockers.description: P45 scripts (load-profile, concurrency-profile, unbounded-concurrency-experiment) are stubs. Not wired into make test-full or CI.
blockers.evidence: Code review of each script confirms empty bodies or hardcoded results.

blockers.description: No standardized machine-readable evidence artifact format for promotion gating.
blockers.evidence: Some tests write ad hoc JSON reports but no consistent schema or evidence service.

blockers.description: No test verifies fail-closed behavior when server, LLM, or database is unavailable.
blockers.evidence: No test file found that validates fail-closed for unavailable dependencies.

blockers.description: No P50 readiness validation report exists. ACCP compiler exists but pre-existing reports cover P43, P44.5, P44.6, P45 only.
blockers.evidence: find reports/accp/P50* returns no results. reports/accp/ contains only P43/, P44.5/, P44.6/, P45/.

blockers.description: No promotion gate exists on the real runtime execution path that checks test coverage.
blockers.evidence: No test or script found that implements a promotion gate based on e2e test results.

blockers.description: Real LLM mode exists but is guarded behind PI_DIAG_RUN_REAL_LLM=1 and never runs in CI.
blockers.evidence: mini-execution-correctness.yml line: PI_REAL_AGENT_GATE_MODE: commit (faux mode). Real-LLM is workflow_dispatch only.

blockers.description: PostgreSQL backend exists but all CI tests use JSON-fallback or in-memory state store.
blockers.evidence: CI workflows do not set DATABASE_URL or PG* environment variables for test runs.

blockers.description: Completion gate tests are unit-tested but not exercised as part of a live end-to-end execution.
blockers.evidence: Completion gate tests (5 files) use isolated in-process testing.

blockers.description: Async assembly tests (22 files) are unit tests, not wired into any real execution runtime.
blockers.evidence: assembly/ directory in test/ contains unit tests, not integration or e2e tests.

blockers.description: Route bus test is an isolated ACCP test, not exercised on the real runtime execution path.
blockers.evidence: test/accp/route-bus.test.ts imports ACCP compiler directly, no runtime wiring.
